relationships.subject: PGE2
relationships.evidence_quote: PGE2-induced potentiation of SOC entry (SOCE) was observed in WT, but not in Orai1 KO DRG neurons.

relationships.subject: EP1
relationships.evidence_quote: Inhibition of Gq/11, PKC, or ERK abolished PGE2-induced SOCE increase, indicating PGE2-induced SOCE enhancement is mediated by EP1-mediated downstream cascade.

relationships.subject: Orai1
relationships.evidence_quote: global or conditional deletion of Orai1 attenuates Complete Freund's adjuvant (CFA)-induced pain hypersensitivity in both male and female mice

key_findings: Orai1 deletion attenuates CFA-induced pain hypersensitivity and PGE2-induced excitability
PGE2 potentiates Orai1-mediated SOCE via EP1-Gq/11-PKC-ERK
